text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened while I was taking a walk through the academy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
No way, this is seriously not happening...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I meant, but...
Well, in a way, my bad.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I bought this tail oil that's been trending
on Umastagram for keeping hair super tame, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My tail gets so gross and sticky after running!
It's totally caked in dust and turf clippings!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even kids playing outside all day
don't have tails like this nowadays...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you know?
Tail grooming is a whole lot of work, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, seriously, right? Heavy track days are the absolute worst.
Like, no matter how much you shower, the mud just never ends.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aww, man! And I just went through the trouble of buying a new one, too.
I'm seriously bummed out~ What should I do~...?
choice_data_list: How about only wearing it on days you don't run?
Find another way to use it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right, totally! As long as we keep it to our
days off, there's no harm done!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, all sorted out!
Time to hit the store and grab some snacks!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehh, does oil even have any use other than just being oil?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ..."Upgrade your regular conditioner by mixing in some leftover oil."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Lucky! That means it won't go to waste! Thanks a bunch, like, seriously☆
